_comment: Fail-open and deliberately-swallowed catch blocks reviewed at wave 14. Each was read and judged correct as written. This file is a BASELINE, and baselines rot: it exists so the gate can refuse NEW ones today rather than waiting for these to be re-annotated by tracks that own the files. When a track edits one of these files, it should move the reason into a FAIL OPEN comment in the code and delete the entry here.

declared.reason: Evidence write for a webhook. A 5xx here would make Svix retry the whole webhook; the retry carries the failure again and the counter catches up.
A broken degradation listener must not break the request it is reporting on. This function exists to report a problem and may not create one.

The limiter itself is broken, which is a bug in this file rather than a Redis outage. Allowing is the lesser harm: refusing means every guarded route returns 429 until someone deploys. It logs loudly.
Deliberately not counted as an event failure. The agent's own run row already carries the error; the event itself was dispatched correctly.
Diagnostics must never be the reason a request fails.

Savepoint rollback during error handling. Throwing here would leave the caller unable to commit the invoice, which is the outcome this function exists to prevent. Re-registered at integration: Track D's edit moved it from line 176.

The evidence write for a dropped automation event has itself failed. Nothing further is available and the caller still receives `reason`. Added by Track D; a second failure on top of the one being recorded must not become the thing that throws.
A broken alert path must not become a second failure on top of the one being alerted about. Re-registered at integration: applying Track D's patch to the same function moved it from line 360.
